relations.subject: Anagarika Govinda
relations.evidence: He studied at the Universities of Naples and Cagliari and made archeological research journeys in North Africa.

relations.subject: Anagarika Govinda
relations.evidence: Hoffman became familiar with the work of German life-philosopher Ludwig Klages whose biocentric metaphysics greatly fascinated him and influenced his approach to and understanding of Buddhism.

relations.subject: Anagarika Govinda
relations.evidence: He was instrumental in founding the International Buddhist Union (IBU) in 1929, of which he made Nyanatiloka the president.

relations.subject: Anagarika Govinda
relations.evidence: Lama Ngawang Kalzang taught meditation to Govinda, who remained in contact with him until his death.

relations.subject: Anagarika Govinda
relations.evidence: Govinda and Li Gotami met Ajo Repa Rinpoche, who, according to Govinda, initiated them into the Kagyüpa school of Tibetan Buddhism.

relations.subject: Anagarika Govinda
relations.evidence: Govinda stayed on in India, teaching German and French at Rabindranath Tagore's Visva-Bharati University in Santinekan.

relations.subject: Anagarika Govinda
relations.evidence: On orders of Tomo Geshe Rimpoche Govinda founded his order, The Buddhist Order Arya Maitreya Mandala, on 14.10.1933.

relations.subject: Anagarika Govinda
relations.evidence: In 1936 he got a teaching position at the University of Patna, from where he gave guest lectures at the universities of Allahabad, Lucknow and Benares.

relations.subject: Anagarika Govinda
relations.evidence: In the camp Govinda stayed with the German monk Nyanaponika Thera, with whom he studied languages, and formed a close friendship that lasted till the end of his life.

relations.subject: Li Gotami
relations.evidence: who, as a painter, had been his student at Santinekan in 1934.
